name: Channel decisions and open questions digest
summary: The person who owns a busy team channel gets a dated digest of the week's messages: decisions and who made them, questions still open and who was asked, promises with and without an owner or a date, and what carried over. Every line cites its message. Nothing is posted.

sources.title: FullyPowered AI's own brief for a weekly digest of one team channel's decisions, open questions and promises, written from a chat export the channel's owner supplies.
